---
title: "Hava Laboratory Tools"
---

```{=html}
<link href="../html/pages.css" rel="stylesheet">
<link href="calculator.css" rel="stylesheet">

<section class="calc-shell">
  <div class="calc-heading">
    <div style="margin-bottom: 2rem;"></div>
    <p class="calc-kicker">Compressible Flow Calculator</p>
    <p>
      Interactive gas-dynamics relations for course work and preliminary analysis.
      This version includes perfect-gas relations and reacting-air equilibrium
      species concentrations for high-temperature estimates.
    </p>
  </div>

  <div class="calc-stage">
    <div class="calc-layout">
      <nav class="calc-tabs" aria-label="Calculator modes">
        <button class="calc-tab is-active" type="button" data-panel="isentropic">Isentropic</button>
        <button class="calc-tab" type="button" data-panel="speed-sound">Speed of sound</button>
        <button class="calc-tab" type="button" data-panel="normal-shock">Normal shock</button>
        <button class="calc-tab" type="button" data-panel="oblique-shock">Oblique shock</button>
        <button class="calc-tab" type="button" data-panel="cone-shock">Cone shock</button>
        <span class="calc-tab-break" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <button class="calc-tab" type="button" data-panel="reacting-air">Reacting Air</button>
        <button class="calc-tab" type="button" data-panel="reacting-normal-shock">Reacting normal shock</button>
        <button class="calc-tab" type="button" data-panel="reacting-oblique-shock">Reacting oblique shock</button>
        <button class="calc-tab" type="button" data-panel="reacting-cone-shock">Reacting cone shock</button>
      </nav>

      <section class="calc-panel is-active" id="isentropic" aria-labelledby="isentropic-title">
        <div class="panel-head">
          <h2 id="isentropic-title">Isentropic Flow Relations</h2>
          <span>Perfect gas</span>
        </div>

        <form class="calc-form" id="isentropic-form">
          <label>
            Gamma, γ
            <input name="gamma" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="1.4">
          </label>
          <label>
            Input
            <select name="input">
            <option value="mach">Mach number</option>
            <option value="tt0">T/T₀</option>
            <option value="pp0">p/p₀</option>
            <option value="rr0">ρ/ρ₀</option>
            <option value="area-sub">A/A* subsonic</option>
            <option value="area-sup">A/A* supersonic</option>
            <option value="mach-angle">Mach angle, deg.</option>
            <option value="pm-angle">Prandtl-Meyer angle, deg.</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          <label>
            Value
          <input name="value" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="2.0">
          </label>
          <button type="submit">Calculate</button>
        </form>

        <p class="calc-error" id="isentropic-error" role="alert"></p>
        <div class="result-grid" id="isentropic-results"></div>
      </section>

      <section class="calc-panel" id="speed-sound" aria-labelledby="speed-sound-title">
        <div class="panel-head">
          <h2 id="speed-sound-title">Speed of Sound</h2>
          <span>a = sqrt(γRT)</span>
        </div>

        <form class="calc-form speed-form" id="speed-sound-form">
          <label>
            Gas
            <select name="gas">
              <option value="air">Air</option>
              <option value="co2">CO₂</option>
              <option value="argon">Argon</option>
              <option value="nitrogen">N₂</option>
              <option value="oxygen">O₂</option>
              <option value="helium">Helium</option>
              <option value="custom">Custom</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          <label>
            Gamma, γ
            <input name="gamma" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="1.4">
          </label>
          <label>
            R, J/(kg K)
            <input name="gasConstant" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="287.05">
          </label>
          <label class="mw-field">
            MW, kg/kmol
            <input name="molecularWeight" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="28.965">
          </label>
          <label>
            T, K
            <input name="temperature" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="288.15">
          </label>
          <button type="submit">Calculate</button>
        </form>

        <p class="calc-error" id="speed-sound-error" role="alert"></p>
        <div class="result-grid" id="speed-sound-results"></div>
      </section>

      <section class="calc-panel" id="normal-shock" aria-labelledby="normal-shock-title">
        <div class="panel-head">
          <h2 id="normal-shock-title">Normal Shock Relations</h2>
          <span>Perfect gas</span>
        </div>

        <div class="calc-subsection-title">Non Dimensional Analysis</div>
        <form class="calc-form" id="normal-shock-form">
          <label>
            Gamma, γ
            <input name="gamma" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="1.4">
          </label>
          <label>
            Input
            <select name="input">
              <option value="m1">M₁</option>
              <option value="m2">M₂</option>
              <option value="p2p1">p₂/p₁</option>
              <option value="r2r1">ρ₂/ρ₁</option>
              <option value="t2t1">T₂/T₁</option>
              <option value="p02p01">p₀₂/p₀₁</option>
              <option value="p1p02">p₁/p₀₂</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          <label>
            Value
          <input name="value" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="2.0">
          </label>
          <button type="submit">Calculate</button>
        </form>

        <p class="calc-error" id="normal-shock-error" role="alert"></p>
        <div class="result-grid" id="normal-shock-results"></div>

        <div class="calc-subsection-title">Dimensional Analysis</div>
        <form class="calc-form normal-shock-dimensional-form" id="normal-shock-dimensional-form">
          <label>
            <span>M<sub>1</sub></span>
            <input name="mach" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="2.0">
          </label>
          <label>
            Gamma, γ
            <input name="gamma" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="1.4">
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>p<sub>1</sub>, Pa</span>
            <input name="pressure" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="101325">
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>T<sub>1</sub>, K</span>
            <input name="temperature" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="288.15">
          </label>
          <button type="submit">Calculate</button>
        </form>

        <p class="calc-error" id="normal-shock-dimensional-error" role="alert"></p>
        <div class="result-grid" id="normal-shock-dimensional-results"></div>
      </section>

      <section class="calc-panel" id="reacting-normal-shock" aria-labelledby="reacting-normal-shock-title">
        <div class="panel-head">
          <h2 id="reacting-normal-shock-title">Reacting Normal Shock</h2>
          <span>Hansen equilibrium</span>
        </div>

        <form class="calc-form reacting-normal-shock-form" id="reacting-normal-shock-form">
          <label>
            <span>M<sub>1</sub></span>
            <input name="mach" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="8">
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>T<sub>1</sub>, K</span>
            <input name="temperature" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="227.13">
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>p<sub>1</sub>, Pa</span>
            <input name="pressure" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="1090.16">
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>N<sub>2</sub> (X)</span>
            <input name="n2Feed" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="0.8">
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>O<sub>2</sub>(X)</span>
            <input name="o2Feed" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="0.2">
          </label>
          <button type="submit">Calculate</button>
        </form>

        <p class="calc-error" id="reacting-normal-shock-error" role="alert"></p>
        <div class="reacting-air-results" id="reacting-normal-shock-results"></div>
      </section>

      <section class="calc-panel" id="oblique-shock" aria-labelledby="oblique-shock-title">
        <div class="panel-head">
          <h2 id="oblique-shock-title">Oblique Shock Relations</h2>
          <span>Perfect gas θ-β-M</span>
        </div>

        <div class="calc-subsection-title">Non Dimensional Analysis</div>
        <form class="calc-form oblique-shock-form" id="oblique-shock-form">
          <label>
            Gamma, γ
            <input name="gamma" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="1.4">
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>M<sub>1</sub></span>
            <input name="mach" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="2.0">
          </label>
          <label>
            θ (turn angle), deg.
            <input name="theta" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="10">
          </label>
          <button type="submit">Calculate</button>
        </form>

        <p class="calc-error" id="oblique-shock-error" role="alert"></p>
        <div class="result-grid" id="oblique-shock-results"></div>

        <div class="calc-subsection-title">Dimensional Analysis</div>
        <form class="calc-form oblique-shock-dimensional-form" id="oblique-shock-dimensional-form">
          <label>
            Gamma, γ
            <input name="gamma" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="1.4">
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>M<sub>1</sub></span>
            <input name="mach" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="2.0">
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>p<sub>1</sub>, Pa</span>
            <input name="pressure" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="101325">
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>T<sub>1</sub>, K</span>
            <input name="temperature" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="288.15">
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>θ (turn angle), deg.</span>
            <input name="theta" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="10">
          </label>
          <button type="submit">Calculate</button>
        </form>

        <p class="calc-error" id="oblique-shock-dimensional-error" role="alert"></p>
        <div class="result-grid" id="oblique-shock-dimensional-results"></div>
      </section>

      <section class="calc-panel" id="cone-shock" aria-labelledby="cone-shock-title">
        <div class="panel-head">
          <h2 id="cone-shock-title">Conical Shock Relations</h2>
          <span>Perfect gas Taylor-Maccoll</span>
        </div>

        <form class="calc-form cone-shock-form" id="cone-shock-form">
          <label>
            Gamma, γ
            <input name="gamma" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="1.4">
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>M<sub>1</sub></span>
            <input name="mach" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="2.0">
          </label>
          <label>
            Cone half-angle, deg.
            <input name="theta" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="10">
          </label>
          <button type="submit">Calculate</button>
        </form>

        <p class="calc-error" id="cone-shock-error" role="alert"></p>
        <div class="result-grid" id="cone-shock-results"></div>
      </section>

      <section class="calc-panel" id="reacting-oblique-shock" aria-labelledby="reacting-oblique-shock-title">
        <div class="panel-head">
          <h2 id="reacting-oblique-shock-title">Reacting Oblique Shock</h2>
          <span>Hansen equilibrium</span>
        </div>

        <form class="calc-form reacting-oblique-shock-form" id="reacting-oblique-shock-form">
          <label>
            <span>M<sub>1</sub></span>
            <input name="mach" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="8">
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>T<sub>1</sub>, K</span>
            <input name="temperature" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="227.13">
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>p<sub>1</sub>, Pa</span>
            <input name="pressure" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="1090.16">
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>θ (turn angle), deg.</span>
            <input name="theta" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="20">
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>N<sub>2</sub> (X)</span>
            <input name="n2Feed" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="0.8">
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>O<sub>2</sub>(X)</span>
            <input name="o2Feed" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="0.2">
          </label>
          <button type="submit">Calculate</button>
        </form>

        <p class="calc-error" id="reacting-oblique-shock-error" role="alert"></p>
        <div class="reacting-air-results" id="reacting-oblique-shock-results"></div>
      </section>

      <section class="calc-panel" id="reacting-cone-shock" aria-labelledby="reacting-cone-shock-title">
        <div class="panel-head">
          <h2 id="reacting-cone-shock-title">Reacting Cone Shock</h2>
          <span>Hansen equilibrium Taylor-Maccoll</span>
        </div>

        <form class="calc-form reacting-cone-shock-form" id="reacting-cone-shock-form">
          <label>
            <span>M<sub>1</sub></span>
            <input name="mach" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="8">
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>T<sub>1</sub>, K</span>
            <input name="temperature" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="227.13">
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>p<sub>1</sub>, Pa</span>
            <input name="pressure" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="1090.16">
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>Cone half-angle, deg.</span>
            <input name="theta" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="20">
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>N<sub>2</sub> (X)</span>
            <input name="n2Feed" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="0.8">
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>O<sub>2</sub>(X)</span>
            <input name="o2Feed" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="0.2">
          </label>
          <button type="submit">Calculate</button>
        </form>

        <p class="calc-error" id="reacting-cone-shock-error" role="alert"></p>
        <div class="reacting-air-results" id="reacting-cone-shock-results"></div>
      </section>

      <section class="calc-panel" id="reacting-air" aria-labelledby="reacting-air-title">
        <div class="panel-head">
          <h2 id="reacting-air-title">Reacting Air Species</h2>
          <span>Hansen equilibrium</span>
        </div>

        <form class="calc-form reacting-air-form" id="reacting-air-form">
          <label>
            T, K
            <input name="temperature" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="4000">
          </label>
          <label>
            p, Pa
            <input name="pressure" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="5066.25">
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>N<sub>2</sub> (X)</span>
            <input name="n2Feed" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="0.8">
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>O<sub>2</sub>(X)</span>
            <input name="o2Feed" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="0.2">
          </label>
          <button type="submit">Calculate</button>
        </form>

        <p class="calc-note">
          Starting species values can be mole fractions or concentrations; the equilibrium chemistry uses their elemental N/O ratio.
          Species are reported as mole fraction (X), mass fraction (Y), and mol/m<sup>3</sup>.
          <br>
          X is mole fraction, Y is mass fraction, and Z is the reacting-air compressibility factor.
        </p>
        <p class="calc-error" id="reacting-air-error" role="alert"></p>
        <div class="reacting-air-results" id="reacting-air-results"></div>
      </section>
    </div>

    <div class="calc-side-image">
      <div class="calc-affiliation-row">
        <img class="calc-rpi-logo" src="Rensselaer_poly_inst_Seal.png" alt="Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute seal">
      </div>
      <p class="calc-credit">
        Special thanks to Prof. William Devenport and the VT Compressible Aerodynamic Calculator for serving as a source of inspiration for this calculator and for Ozgur Tumuklu’s personal and classroom use over the years in perfect-gas calculations.
        <br>
        For the reacting air model, O. Tumuklu acknowledges the contributions of C. Frederick Hansen, whose algorithm was defined in the NASA TR R-50 technical report, and Semih Olcmen’s group for their recent publication: <a href="https://doi.org/10.3390/axioms15040283" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Axioms paper</a>.
      </p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<script src="calculator.js"></script>
```
